title: ScoredChunk
description: A retrieval hit: a full Chunk shape (per chunk.schema.json) plus a cosine-similarity score and an optional reranker score. Returned by VectorStore.search (docs/contracts/vector-store-interface.md) and optionally re-emitted by Reranker.rerank (docs/contracts/reranker-interface.md, ADR-0012). Composition over Chunk rather than field-duplication so the chunk shape has one source of truth.

chunk.description: The full Chunk shape; mirrors what is stored in the chunks table after the vector-store adapter joins the Postgres row back onto the vector payload.

score.description: Retrieval score. For dense-only retrieval, cosine similarity in [0.0, 1.0]. For hybrid retrieval (ADR-0011), the server-side RRF-fused score (normalized into [0.0, 1.0] by the adapter). Higher is more similar.

rerankScore.description: Optional reranker output (ADR-0012). Populated by a certified Reranker route when active; null otherwise. A4 sorts by rerankScore when present, falling back to score. Cross-encoder rerankers return continuous floats in [0.0, 1.0]; managed-API rerankers (e.g., Cohere) are normalized into the same range by the adapter. Writing to this field is forbidden outside the reranker adapter.
